propositions: complexity-baseline.json lacks a CI lock equivalent to module-size-limit.txt, allowing any contributor to modify the file
the baseline entry count can grow silently by adding new function entries without triggering a gate failure
CI must semantically compare the baseline against main and reject raised ceilings or added entries, permitting only removals or lowered ceilings
the module-size-limit lock must fail closed (not emit a warning and continue) when fetching main fails, preventing unverified branch values from passing the cap
adding a new high-complexity function with a matching baseline entry in the same change must fail CI until the override gate is satisfied
baseline shrinkage (removing entries or lowering ceilings) must pass without override to keep the ratchet functional
